metadata.description: Six deep skills for the work where a capable model's default falls short: writing that reads as human, visuals, design judgment, and code change, review and merge.

plugins.name: engineering-lifecycle
plugins.description: Design judgment (contracts, data and migrations, failure modes), code changes with diagnosis and tests, review, and provably complete merges.

plugins.name: professional-craft
plugins.description: Writing that reads as a person wrote it, and decks, charts and pages checked at real size.

plugins.name: core-rules
plugins.description: Recommended: eight always-on working rules (outcomes, evidence, untrusted text, go-ahead, secrets, skill routing) injected at session start.
